chunks: What Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Abū Khālid al-Qammāṭ, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “A man who recognizes his own view at one time and denies it at another, is the divorce of his guardian over him permissible?”
So he said: “What is the matter with him? Does he not divorce himself?”
He said: I said, “He does not know the limit of divorce, and one cannot feel secure about him that if he divorces today, he may say tomorrow: I did not divorce.”
So he said: “I do not see him except in the position of the Imam, meaning the guardian.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: a figure of governing legal authority used here by way of comparison
key_terms.الْوَلِيَّ: the guardian intended in the Imam’s clarification
key_terms.حَدَّ الطَّلَاقِ: the legal parameters and proper understanding of divorce
key_terms.رَأْيَهُ: his own judgment or awareness of his state
key_terms.رَجُلٌ: a man whose legal capacity is being discussed
key_terms.طَلَاقُ: divorce as a formal legal act
key_terms.وَلِيِّهِ: his guardian who may exercise authority on his behalf

ai.seo_question: Can a guardian issue divorce on behalf of a mentally unstable man in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal validity of divorce in the case of a man whose mental state is unstable and unreliable. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام indicates that when such a person cannot be trusted to comprehend or uphold the act of divorce, the guardian assumes an authoritative legal position over him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4772 - Ṣafwan ibn Yaḥya narrated from Abu Khalid al-Qammaṭ, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (as): "A man who sometimes understands his own position and at other times denies it, can his guardian (wali) issue a divorce on his behalf?"
Imam (as) said: "What is wrong with him? Can he not divorce himself?"
I said: "He does not understand the rules of divorce, and if he divorces today, he might say tomorrow that he did not divorce."
Imam (as) said: "I see him (wali) as being in the position of an Imam - that is, the guardian (wali) has authority over him."
